lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: prahalaad jan charanee laagaa aai ||11||
lines.translation: The humble servant Prahlaad came and fell at the Lord's Feet. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur naam nidhaan driRaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru implanted the treasure of the Naam within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj maal jhoothee sabh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Power, property and all Maya is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭੀ ਨਰ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobhee nar rahe lapataai ||
lines.translation: But still, the greedy people continue clinging to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam bin daragah milai sajaai ||12||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortals are punished in His Court. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sabh ko kare karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, everyone acts as the Lord makes them act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: se paravaan jinee har siu chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: They alone are approved and accepted, who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kaa a(n)geekaar karadaa aaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has made His devotees His Own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karatai apanaa roop dikhaaiaa ||13||1||2||
lines.translation: The Creator has appeared in His Own Form. ||13||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te a(n)mrit phal paaiaa haumai trisan bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, I obtain the Ambrosial Fruit; my egotism and desire have been quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam hridai man vasiaa manasaa manahi samaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord dwells within my heart and mind, and the desires of my mind are quieted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kripaa karahu mere piaare ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, my Beloved, please bless me with Your Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har gun deen jan maa(n)gai gur kai sabad udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, Your humble servant begs for Your Glorious Praises; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kau jam johi na saakai ratee a(n)ch dookh na laaee ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch the humble Saints; it does not cause them even an iota of suffering or pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarahi sagale kul taarahi jo teree saranaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Lord, save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kee paij rakhahi too aape eh teree vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: You Yourself save the honor of Your devotees; this is Your Glory, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh kaatahi dubidhaa ratee na raaee ||3||
lines.translation: You cleanse them of the sins and the pains of countless incarnations; You love them without even an iota of duality. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham mooR mugadh kichh boojhahi naahee too aape dehi bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: I am foolish and ignorant, and understand nothing. You Yourself bless me with understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karasee avar na karanaa jaaee ||4||
lines.translation: You do whatever You please; nothing else can be done at all. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat upaai tudh dha(n)dhai laaiaa bhoo(n)dee kaar kamaaee ||
lines.translation: Creating the world, You have linked all to their tasks - even the evil deeds which men do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jooai haariaa sabadai surat na paaee ||5||
lines.translation: They lose this precious human life in the gamble, and do not understand the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh marahi tin kichhoo na soojhai duramat agiaan a(n)dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die, understanding nothing; they are enveloped by the darkness of evil-mindedness and ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bhavajal paar na paavahi kab hee doob mue bin gur sir bhaaraa ||6||
lines.translation: They do not cross over the terrible world-ocean; without the Guru, they drown and die. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad rate jan saache har prabh aap milaae ||
lines.translation: True are those humble beings who are imbued with the True Shabad; the Lord God unites them with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee baanee sabad pachhaatee saach rahe liv laae ||7||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they come to understand the Shabad. They remain lovingly focused on the True Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aap niramal tere jan hai niramal gur kai sabad veechaare ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are Immaculate and Pure, and pure are Your humble servants who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaarai raam naam ur dhaare ||8||2||3||
lines.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those, who enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts. ||8||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhairau mahalaa 5 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai soee vad raajaa ||
lines.translation: He alone is a great king, who keeps the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai tis poore kaajaa ||
lines.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his tasks are perfectly accomplished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai tin kot dhan paae ||
lines.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, obtains millions of treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa janam birathaa jaae ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, life is useless. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis saalaahee jis har dhan raas ||
lines.translation: I praise that person, who has the capital of the Lord's Wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so vadabhaagee jis gur masatak haath ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is very fortunate, on whose forehead the Guru has placed His Hand. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਟ ਕਈ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai tis kot kaee sainaa ||
lines.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, has many millions of armies on his side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naam ridai tis sahaj sukhainaa ||
lines.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, enjoys peace and poise.
